items.title: American SI Exports Program; On-Demand Consortia for Specific Foreign Opportunities (Commerce/ITA notice)
items.source: Federal Register (U.S. Department of Commerce, ITA)
items.excerpt: Commerce's International Trade Administration sets up an On-Demand Consortia pathway under the Super Intelligence (SI) Exports Program created by EO 14320, so industry consortia can apply from Nov 30 to have full-stack US AI export packages designated for specific foreign opportunities. It also adds re-designation/de-designation rules and plans to reopen the Pre-Set Consortia pathway. (Filed for public inspection 11-25 08:45 ET; published in the FR 11-27.)

items.title: Quantifying artificial intelligence (AI) compute user demand / UK AI compute benefits realisation report
items.excerpt: The UK government published an independent report estimating present and future advanced AI compute needs across academia, industry and government, alongside a benefits-realisation and return-on-investment report on its AI compute infrastructure spending (AIRR).

items.title: UK cracks down on online abuse ahead of international summit seeking to end violence against women and girls
items.excerpt: The FCDO launched the £27m Thrive programme to tackle the growing use of AI and online platforms to stalk, harass and create non-consensual intimate images of women and girls, working with tech firms on safety-by-design (image blurring, age limits) and helping other countries close online-safety-law loopholes. A London summit is set for 27-28 April 2027.

items.title: 산자위, 산업 AI전환·활용 촉진법안(M.AX법) 의결…제조업 지원
items.excerpt: 국회 산자위가 26일 전체회의에서 '산업 인공지능 전환 및 활용 촉진법'(M.AX법)을 여야 합의로 의결했다. 제조업 AI 전환 얼라이언스와 암묵지 데이터 지원사업의 법적 근거를 마련했고, 외국인투자 안보심의 근거 신설 등도 함께 의결돼 법사위·본회의로 넘어간다.

items.title: 공정위, 애플 '시리' AI기능 지연…부당광고 혐의 심의 착수
items.excerpt: 공정위 심사관이 애플·애플코리아가 아이폰16 판매 때 제공 시기가 불확실한 '애플 인텔리전스' AI 기능(개인 맥락 시리 등 4개)을 정상 이용 가능한 것처럼 광고했다며 표시광고법 위반 심사보고서를 24일 위원회에 상정했다. 관련 매출액 3조3527억원 기준 과징금 의견을 냈고, 애플은 결론에 동의하지 않는다는 입장이다.

items.title: Enforce AI nudifier ban, MEPs warn
items.excerpt: Eighty-one MEPs sent a cross-party letter demanding the Commission and EU governments be ready to enforce the AI Act's ban on 'nudifier' apps from day one, 2 December, warning that several member states still lack enforcement structures and urging infringement procedures and proactive checks.

items.title: Spanish opposition criticised for AI video of Pedro Sánchez in Morocco shirt
items.excerpt: Spain's People's Party posted an AI-altered version of a Sánchez campaign clip making it appear he put on a Morocco shirt, without any AI disclosure, prompting criticism that it may fall short of EU AI Act Article 50 transparency obligations days before Sunday's general election.

items.title: Dozens of court cases in England and Wales affected by undisclosed AI use in 2026
items.excerpt: A Bureau of Investigative Journalism trawl of published judgments found at least 25 cases in 2026 affected by undisclosed AI use, including AI-written witness statements and fictitious case law, despite judicial AI guidance; the supreme court's Lord Sales said the court is 'increasingly concerned'.

items.title: India's government ponders cradle to grave AI oversight
items.excerpt: Indian politicians have proposed a major AI role in citizens' lives, partly through pervasive data collection: PM Modi spelled out a vision for an AI-based app that would collect data on children as they grow to assess aptitude for different careers.

items.title: Microsoft: Hackers in China, N Korea using ARTEX AI tool to break into global tech systems
items.excerpt: Microsoft threat intelligence says state-linked groups in China (incl. Salt Typhoon) and North Korea are using ARTEX, an agentic offensive AI framework that automates familiar attack techniques with specialised agents and little human involvement.

items.title: Nvidia halts server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, and Indonesia after tighter US export controls
items.excerpt: Nvidia told partners such as Dell and Supermicro to stop shipping servers with its chips to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia after new US curbs took effect requiring licences for those markets (per FT).

items.title: After OpenAI and Anthropic shut the door on their data, a Chinese AI developer is turning to Google and Meta instead
items.excerpt: Z.AI and Moonshot AI are delaying next flagship models after the US closed the Nvidia cloud loophole, Nvidia halted Southeast Asia shipments and US labs cracked down on distillation; Z.AI's ~3T-parameter GLM-5.5 likely slips to Q1 2027 (Reuters via The Decoder).

items.title: AI is straining America's open records systems
items.excerpt: Startups are mining public-records laws to feed AI products while citizens use chatbots to file more requests, swamping small-town clerks and prompting questions about how FOIA-style systems should handle AI-driven volume.

items.title: AI 윤리원칙 자율점검표 연내 공개…해설서는 내년
items.excerpt: AI 기본법 제27조에 따라 8월 제정된 '대한민국 인공지능 윤리원칙'의 실천 기준으로, KISDI가 AI 사업자용 자율점검표를 연내, 해설서를 내년 상반기 공개한다. 과기정통부·KISDI AI 사회정책 포럼에서는 학습데이터 기록·보유 의무, 생성물 표시 차등화 등 정책 제언도 나왔다.

items.title: Meta Refused to Share Muse for Testing, UK Financial Watchdog Complains
items.excerpt: The UK Financial Conduct Authority said Meta declined its request for joint testing of the Muse personal AI agent before its UK launch; the FCA wants to understand how agents make payments and act autonomously in consumers' interest.
